statusHint.needs_human: A step only you can do

drop.visual: Loose film frames that line up when a folder is dragged over
drop.title: Drop a folder with footage
drop.body: Clipsana checks every clip and tells you what would trip up the edit. Originals are never changed.

profile.label: Profile
profile.social: 30 fps, up to 4K, DNxHR HQ for smooth editing
profile.ipad: 30 fps, 1080p, light H.264 for iPad and laptops

table.caption: Scanned clips
table.keys: Keyboard: Tab moves between rows, Space selects, Enter opens the detail, F fixes the selection.

cadence.aria: Frames arrive unevenly, pass the viewfinder gate and leave evenly spaced at the chosen frame rate
cadence.jobAria: Frames of the running job passing through the gate
cadence.uneven: The gaps are uneven, so fast motion can stutter slightly. Pick the rate your timeline uses.

job.gpuBusy: 3D previews are paused while the GPU converts

ai.summary: Claude scanned 01_raw and asks to convert three clips with variable frame rate. Nothing runs until you approve.
ai.modalBody: One ffmpeg command per clip. Originals stay untouched; results go to 02_edit.

settings.motionHint: Off also stops 3D previews. Your Windows setting is respected either way.

ks.title: Design system
ks.intro: Every building block of Clipsana in one place, working with sample data from real test clips. Switch theme, accent and language at the top; drag a folder onto the viewfinder, select clips, run the demo job.
ks.s1Intro: One main action: drop a folder. The frames line up when a folder hovers over the viewfinder.
ks.previewDragHint: Shows the state you see while dragging a folder
ks.s2Intro: The cards filter the table. Select clips and fix them in one go.
ks.s3Intro: Open a clip with Enter or a double click. Change the target rate to see how many frames get left out or repeated.
ks.s4Intro: Progress, speed and the frames passing through, driven by the job itself.
ks.s5Intro: What an assistant asks for over MCP waits here for your decision.
ks.coloursIntro: Contrast ratio against the page and against panels. WCAG AA needs 4.5 for text.
ks.typeBody: The phone recorded at 60 fps but wrote frames unevenly.
ks.logoIntro: A "C" left open where playback starts. Shown at app-icon sizes down to 16 px and next to the name; the arc follows the accent.
